RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
NORAD catalog number of the spacecraft carrying this emitter. Joins to
CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID. 0 when unbound.

ID_TRANSMITTER.description:
Identifier of the physical transmitter, transceiver or transponder this
record describes (e.g. an upstream transmitter database's UUID). Uplink
and downlink
records of the same device share this value.

LINK_DIRECTION.description: Direction of this emission relative to the spacecraft.

BAUD.description: Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud.

SERVICE.description: Regulatory/ITU service designation (e.g. Amateur, Earth Exploration).

INVERT.description: True when the modulation sideband is inverted.

IARU_COORDINATION.description: IARU frequency-coordination state (e.g. IARU Coordinated, Uncoordinated).

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires this record to
carry downstream.

TIMCcsdsTimeCode.description: CCSDS time-code payload and preamble metadata.

PREAMBLE_FIELD2.description: Second CCSDS preamble field octet; ignored when not signaled by preamble 1.

AGENCY_DEFINED_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional agency-defined epoch timestamp for agency epoch time codes.

CCSDS_EPOCH_ISO8601.description: Optional CCSDS epoch override timestamp; defaults to 1958-01-01T00:00:00 TAI.

TIMInstant.description: Numeric or textual instant tagged with its time system and representation.

EPOCH_FORMAT.description: Interpretation of JULIAN_DATE, SECONDS, and ISO8601.

JULIAN_DATE.description: Julian Date or Modified Julian Date day value, selected by EPOCH_FORMAT.

SECONDS.description: Seconds for UNIX_SECONDS, GPS_SECONDS, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS, or MISSION_ELAPSED_SECONDS.

ISO8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp text for ISO8601 inputs or display outputs.

SUBSECOND_NANOS.description: Additional nanoseconds beyond the fractional scalar/text value.

EPOCH_LABEL.description: Optional application-defined epoch label for MET, MRT, or SCLK values.

GNSS_WEEK.description: GNSS week number when EPOCH_FORMAT is GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS.

GNSS_ROLLOVER_REFERENCE_ISO8601.description: Optional Orekit-style GNSS week rollover reference timestamp.

CCSDS_TIME_CODE.description: CCSDS time-code payload when EPOCH_FORMAT is CCSDS_TIME_CODE.

TIMConversionRequest.description: Request to convert one instant into another time system/representation.

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: Optional TAI-UTC override in seconds for the source instant.

HAS_TAI_MINUS_UTC.description: Whether TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS should override runtime leap-second data.

DUT1_SECONDS.description: Optional UT1-UTC override in seconds for UT1 conversions.

HAS_DUT1.description: Whether DUT1_SECONDS should override runtime Earth-orientation data.

TIMConversionResult.description: Result of a time conversion request.

DELTA_SECONDS.description: Target minus source offset in SI seconds for the requested conversion.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Legacy time-system selector retained for existing TIM consumers.

RFLObstruction.description:
One obstacle interaction on one sample's path. SPARSE: entries exist only
where an interaction was computed, so a clear path is never encoded as a
row of zeroes.

This is the join that makes an arbitrary 3D object a first-class part of
the link budget: MATERIAL_ID names the `$RFS` record whose permittivity,
conductivity, penetration loss and roughness produced LOSS_DB, and
GEOMETRY_REF_ID names the exact mesh, face set, panel or analytic shape
inside it that was hit.

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this interaction applies to.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface that was hit. An obstruction loss with
no material is an unattributed number: a metal panel and a plasterboard
wall of the same size do entirely different things to a link.

VAM_ID.description:
`$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh, when the obstacle is a
reviewed 3D asset.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the obstacle is a catalogued object (an
occulting spacecraft, a structure on another vehicle). 0 when unbound.

INCIDENCE_ANGLE_DEG.description: Angle between the incident ray and the surface normal, degrees [0-90).

PATH_LENGTH_IN_MATERIAL_M.description:
Path length travelled INSIDE the material, metres. With
`$RFS.ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M` this is what makes penetration loss
reproducible instead of a stated constant.

EXCESS_DELAY_S.description: Extra propagation delay of a reflected or scattered component, seconds.

FRESNEL_CLEARANCE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of the first Fresnel zone still clear [0-1]. 1 means the zone is
untouched.

DISTANCE_FROM_TRANSMITTER_M.description: Distance from the transmitter to the interaction point, metres.

RFLEndpoint.description:
One endpoint of a link. Identity ONLY — position, antenna geometry and band
capability are NOT copied here; they are joined from the standard named by
ENDPOINT_KIND. A copied position silently goes stale against its source.

ENDPOINT_ID.description: Producer-stable identifier for this endpoint within the record.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the endpoint is an on-orbit object. 0 when
unbound — never a placeholder catalogue number.

RFB_ID.description:
`$RFB.ID` — the band specification (frequency, bandwidth, EIRP, gains,
polarization) this endpoint transmits or receives on.

RFE_ID.description: `$RFE.ID` — the parametric emitter description, when one exists.

IQC_ID.description: `$IQC` capture identifier, when the samples were derived from a recording.

CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel or carrier identifier within the beam.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization actually used on this link. Defaults to UNKNOWN explicitly:
`rfPolarization` ordinal 0 is LHCP, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as a real polarization.

RFLModCod.description:
One modulation-and-coding choice available to a link. The table carries
engineering capability only; catalogue or recommendation names belong in
ID / NAME and provenance data, never in the schema vocabulary.

MODCOD_ID.description: Stable identifier within the containing link's MODCOD_SET.

CODE_RATE.description: Information bits divided by coded bits, in (0,1].

REQUIRED_MARGIN_DB.description: Additional implementation margin required before this entry is selected.

MAXIMUM_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Optional ceiling imposed by framing or implementation, bits per second.

RFLLink.description: One link whose budget is sampled by this record.

LINK_ID.description:
Producer-stable link identifier. Joins `$ACI.ACIInterval.LINK_ID` and
`$LKS.ID` when the same link also has an operational-state record.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Carrier centre frequency actually used, megahertz — the `$RFB` MHz
convention, NOT the `$IQC` hertz convention. A consumer joining the two
converts explicitly at the join. Band designation is NOT duplicated here:
it is joined from `$RFB.BAND`.

MODULATION.description: Modulation as the producer states it (e.g. "QPSK", "8PSK", "16APSK").

CODING.description: Forward error correction scheme as the producer states it.

SYMBOL_RATE_BAUD.description:
Symbol rate in baud (symbols per second), NOT kilobaud — the `$RFB.BAUD`
convention.

DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Information bit rate the budget is stated for, bits per second.

THRESHOLD_TERM.description:
Required threshold this link is evaluated against. THRESHOLD_TERM,
THRESHOLD_VALUE, THRESHOLD_UNITS and THRESHOLD_COMPARISON are meaningful
only together; a LINK_MARGIN_DB column without them states a margin
against an unstated requirement and MUST be refused.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this link belongs to. Links sharing a RECEIVER_GROUP_ID
and CHANNEL_GROUP_ID are mutually interfering and MUST be evaluated
together; a producer that shards a link matrix MUST keep a group intact
within one shard.

CONSTELLATION.description: Constellation or network this link belongs to.

MODCOD_SET.description:
Ordered adaptive modulation-and-coding choices. Per-sample
SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX indexes this vector for the sample's selected link.

ACM_ENABLED.description: Whether the producer evaluated adaptive selection for this link.

RFLInterferenceContribution.description:
One interfering contribution to one sample. SPARSE: entries exist only
where a contribution was computed, so a dense matrix is never forced into
existence to say "no interference computed".

SAMPLE_INDEX.description: Index into the sample arrays this contribution applies to.

SOURCE_ENDPOINT_ID.description:
Endpoint identifier of the interfering emitter, when it is an endpoint of
this record.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Interfering object's catalogue number, 0 when unbound.

INTERFERENCE_POWER_DBW.description: Received interfering power at the victim receiver, dBW.

TOPOCENTRIC_SEPARATION_DEG.description:
Angular separation between the wanted and interfering paths at the
victim receiver, degrees.

SPECTRAL_OVERLAP_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the victim's bandwidth overlapped by this emission [0-1].

POLARIZATION_ISOLATION_DB.description: Polarization isolation applied to this contribution, dB.

ANTENNA_DISCRIMINATION_DB.description: Discrimination applied from the victim antenna pattern, dB.

RFLModelParameter.description:
A named parameter of a model binding, with its unit stated. There is no
encoding for a parameter value without a unit.

TEXT_VALUE.description: Non-numeric parameter value, when the parameter is categorical.

RFLModelBinding.description:
Which model produced one term of the budget. A loss term without a model
binding is an unattributed number: rain attenuation from two different
recommendations differs by decibels, and a consumer must be able to tell
which one it is holding.

TERM.description: The budget term this binding produced.

MODEL_NAME.description:
Model or recommendation identifier as its publisher states it (e.g. an
ITU-R recommendation number with its revision).

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` of the module that evaluated it.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact artifact that produced the values.

RFLProvenance.description: Where this sample set came from, stated once for the record.

SOURCE.description:
The producing system, dataset or measurement campaign. Required: a
budget time series with no stated source is not publishable.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference that regenerates this set.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Identifier of the propagator that produced the geometry columns. A record
whose METHOD is MODELED or HYBRID and which carries geometry columns MUST
name it: geometry is only as good as the propagator, and the propagator is
a pluggable choice, never an assumed default.

PROPAGATOR_CONFIGURATION.description: Force model or configuration identifier handed to the propagator.

SAMPLING_STEP_S.description: Uniform sampling step, seconds. Absent when SAMPLE_EPOCHS are irregular.

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description:
Weather or environment dataset the atmospheric terms were evaluated
against, when they were not evaluated against a statistical model.

TERRAIN_DATASET.description: Terrain or surface dataset the blockage terms were evaluated against.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this set was computed or recorded.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix ms the upstream inputs were retrieved.

LICENSE.description:
Licence the source imposes on redistribution. An empty LICENSE means
UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a grant to redistribute.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: True when the licence forbids commercial use of this set.

CITATION.description: Attribution the licence requires this record to carry downstream.

MODULE_ID.description:
Primary `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced this record.
MODELS remains the per-budget-term attribution surface.

MODULE_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the exact producing WASM artifact.

RFL_ID.description: Stable identifier of this sample set.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$ACI` and
`$CVP` products derived from this set.

LINKS.description: Link definitions. SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES index into this vector.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Number of samples. Every present metric array MUST have exactly this
many entries.

SAMPLE_LINK_INDEXES.description: Index into LINKS for each sample.

SAMPLE_EPOCHS.description:
Sample epochs, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM. Samples
need not be uniformly spaced and need not be grouped by link, but MUST be
non-decreasing within each link.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale SAMPLE_EPOCHS are expressed in. Defaults to UTC explicitly:
`timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST, so an unset field would otherwise
decode as sidereal time.

RANGE_RATE_M_S.description: Range rate, metres per second; positive is opening.

AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the receiving endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the receiving endpoint, degrees above the local horizon.

TRANSMIT_AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth at the transmitting endpoint, degrees east of north [0-360).

TRANSMIT_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Elevation at the transmitting endpoint, degrees.

DOPPLER_SHIFT_HZ.description:
Doppler shift of the carrier, hertz; positive is closing. Hertz, not the
MHz used for frequencies elsewhere in this record — a shift of a few kHz
on a GHz carrier is destroyed by an MHz encoding.

EIRP_DBW.description: Effective isotropic radiated power toward the receiver, dBW.

TRANSMIT_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain in the direction of the receiver, dBi.

RECEIVE_ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain in the direction of the transmitter, dBi.

GASEOUS_ABSORPTION_LOSS_DB.description: Gaseous (oxygen and water vapour) absorption, dB.

OBSTRUCTION_LOSS_DB.description:
Total loss from 3D obstacles on the path, dB. The per-obstacle detail —
which object, which material, at what angle, through how much of it — is
in OBSTRUCTIONS.

TOTAL_PATH_LOSS_DB.description:
Total of all path terms actually applied, dB. Published as its own column
rather than left to the consumer to sum: a producer that applied a term
this schema has no column for MUST still report an honest total, and the
discrepancy against the itemised columns is then visible.

RECEIVED_POWER_DBW.description: Received carrier power at the receiver input, dBW.

GAIN_TO_NOISE_TEMPERATURE_DB_PER_K.description: Receiving system figure of merit G/T, dB/K.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_DB.description: Carrier-to-noise ratio C/N in the occupied bandwidth, dB.

ENERGY_PER_BIT_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Energy per bit to noise density Eb/N0, dB.

BIT_ERROR_RATE.description:
Bit error rate as a probability [0-1], NOT an exponent and NOT a
percentage. 1e-6 is encoded 1e-6.

LINK_MARGIN_DB.description:
Link margin against the link's stated threshold, dB. Meaningless without
RFLLink.THRESHOLD_TERM / THRESHOLD_VALUE / THRESHOLD_COMPARISON.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY_BPS.description: Achievable channel capacity, bits per second.

CARRIER_TO_NOISE_PLUS_INTERFERENCE_DB.description: Carrier to noise-plus-interference ratio C/(N+I), dB.

OBSTRUCTIONS.description:
Per-interaction obstacle detail, sparse. Each entry names the `$RFS`
material it went through, reflected off or was blocked by.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS.description: The single condition that bound the link at each sample.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description required when a LIMITING_CONSTRAINTS entry is OTHER.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of the whole set. Required: an unattributed budget is not
publishable.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over the size-prefixed
FlatBuffer projection with both 64-byte signature payloads zeroed while
preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM` over canonical JSON with IDL
field order, IDL capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both
signature fields omitted.

SELECTED_MODCOD_INDEX.description:
Index into the selected link's RFLLink.MODCOD_SET for each sample.
SELECTED_MODCOD_VALID distinguishes index 0 from no selection.

SPECTRAL_EFFICIENCY_BPS_HZ.description: Spectral efficiency delivered by the selected entry, bit/s/Hz.

ACHIEVED_DATA_RATE_BPS.description: Delivered information rate after adaptive selection, bits per second.

ACM_MARGIN_DB.description: Margin above the selected entry's threshold, dB.

ENERGY_PER_SYMBOL_TO_NOISE_DENSITY_DB.description: Symbol energy to noise spectral density, dB.

CVPEmitterRef.description:
An emitter that contributed to this geometry. Identity and the few
parameters that determine the boundary; everything else is joined from
`$RFB` and `$RFE`.

EMITTER_ID.description: Producer-stable emitter identifier within this record.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: `$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the emitter is on orbit. 0 when unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID` when the emitter is a terrestrial site.

ID_BEAM.description: Beam and channel within the emitter.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description: Carrier centre frequency, megahertz — the `$RFB` convention.

EIRP_DBW.description: EIRP toward boresight used in the evaluation, dBW.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization, defaulted to UNKNOWN explicitly because `rfPolarization`
ordinal 0 is LHCP.

LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Emitter position at EPOCH, when the geometry is instantaneous. Geodetic
degrees and metres. Absent means "join it from the source record" — a
stale copied position is worse than none.

CONTRIBUTION_WEIGHT.description: Weight of this emitter's contribution to a union or aggregate [0-1].

CVPReceiverRef.description:
A receiver the coverage was evaluated FOR. Coverage is never absolute: a
-110 dBW contour means one thing for a 60 cm terminal and another for a
12 m dish, so the assumed receiver is part of the record.

MIN_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Minimum elevation the receiver can work at, degrees.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this receiver belongs to, matching
`$RFL.RFLLink.RECEIVER_GROUP_ID`.

CVPObstacleRef.description:
A 3D obstacle that shaped this coverage boundary. A footprint clipped by
buildings, a spacecraft structure or terrain is a claim about those
objects; publishing the obstacle set with its `$RFS` materials is what
makes the clipped boundary reproducible.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface. Absent means the obstacle was treated
as an opaque blocker with no material physics — which a consumer is
entitled to know.

VAM_ID.description: `$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: `$CAT` identity when the obstacle is a catalogued object. 0 when unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID` when the obstacle is a structure at a terrestrial site.

INTERACTION.description: How the obstacle acted on the field.

LATITUDE_DEG.description: Geodetic placement of a fixed obstacle, degrees and metres.

CVPUncertainty.description:
How wrong this geometry can be. A contour with no uncertainty is a drawing,
not a measurement.

HORIZONTAL_POSITION_M.description:
1-sigma horizontal position uncertainty of the boundary, metres. Applies
to every vertex unless VERTEX_POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M is present.

LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY.description:
1-sigma uncertainty of the level the contour was drawn at, in
LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY_UNITS.

CONFIDENCE.description: Confidence the stated uncertainties correspond to [0-1], e.g. 0.68.

EXTRACTION_TOLERANCE.description: Tolerance the contour extractor converged to, in the metric's units.

SIMPLIFICATION_TOLERANCE_M.description:
Simplification tolerance applied to the rings, metres. A simplified ring
is not the computed boundary and MUST say so.

METHOD.description:
How the uncertainty was established (e.g. "grid resolution bound",
"Monte Carlo over emitter state covariance").

SOURCE.description: Producing system, dataset or campaign. Required.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Propagator that produced the emitter geometry. A MODELED or HYBRID
product MUST name it.

MODELS.description:
Per-term model bindings for the metric that was contoured, reusing the
`$RFL` binding so a footprint and the samples behind it cite the same
models.

CONTOUR_ALGORITHM.description:
Algorithm that turned the sampled field into rings (e.g. "marching
squares", "alpha shape", "H3 cell union").

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description: Environment and terrain datasets the evaluation used.

OBSTACLE_DATASET.description: Dataset the 3D obstacles and their materials were drawn from.

LICENSE.description: Licence terms. Empty means UNKNOWN TERMS.

COVERAGE_ID.description: Stable identifier of this geometry product.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$RFL` samples
and `$ACI` intervals of the same study.

METRIC_UNITS.description: Units of the metric and of POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES.

THRESHOLD_VALUE.description: The threshold the boundary was drawn at, for a THRESHOLD_CONTOUR.

EPOCH.description:
Instantaneous epoch, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM.
Set for FOOTPRINT and other instantaneous products; NaN for aggregates.

INTERVAL_START.description:
Interval this geometry holds over, same encoding. Set for aggregated
products (union over a window, availability contour); NaN for
instantaneous ones. A product that states neither EPOCH nor an interval
is untethered in time and MUST be refused.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale all epochs in this record are expressed in. Defaults to UTC
explicitly: `timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST.

GENERATION.description:
Monotonic generation of this coverage product within its COVERAGE_ID
lineage. A streaming producer increments it per emission; a consumer
holding a higher generation MUST NOT be overwritten by a lower one.

SUPERSEDES_COVERAGE_ID.description: COVERAGE_ID this record replaces, when the lineage was re-identified.

VERTEX_LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Vertex latitudes, geodetic degrees in [-90, 90]. Same length as
VERTEX_LONGITUDE_DEG.

VERTEX_ALTITUDE_M.description:
Vertex altitudes, metres above ALTITUDE_REFERENCE. Absent when the
geometry lies on the reference surface.

FIXED_ALTITUDE_M.description: The constant altitude, metres, when ALTITUDE_REFERENCE is FIXED_ALTITUDE.

RING_OFFSETS.description: Ring start indexes; RING_COUNT + 1 entries, last equals the vertex count.

RING_POLYGON_INDEXES.description: Polygon each ring belongs to. Same length as RING_COUNT.

RING_ROLES.description: Role of each ring. Same length as RING_COUNT.

POLYGON_COUNT.description:
Number of polygons; equals max(RING_POLYGON_INDEXES) + 1 and is published
so an empty coverage field (zero polygons, zero rings) is representable
and distinguishable from an unpopulated record.

POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES.description:
Metric value each polygon is drawn at, in METRIC_UNITS. Same length as
POLYGON_COUNT. Carried for ISO_METRIC_CONTOUR; for a THRESHOLD_CONTOUR
every entry equals THRESHOLD_VALUE.

POLYGON_LEVEL_UNCERTAINTIES.description: 1-sigma uncertainty of each polygon's level, same units and length.

POLYGON_AREA_KM2.description: Surface area enclosed by each polygon, square kilometres.

VERTEX_POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description:
Per-vertex 1-sigma horizontal uncertainty, metres. Same length as the
vertex arrays. Absent means CVPUncertainty.HORIZONTAL_POSITION_M governs
the whole boundary.

GRID_SCHEME.description:
Grid the field was sampled on before contouring, e.g. "H3" or
"GEODETIC_LATLON". A contour is never finer than the grid behind it.

GRID_RESOLUTION.description: Grid resolution in the scheme's own convention (H3 resolution 0-15).

GRID_SPACING_DEG.description: Grid spacing in degrees, for a geodetic lat/lon grid.

CVG_COVERAGE_ID.description:
`$CVG.COVERAGE_ID` of the figure-of-merit grid this geometry was
contoured from, when one was published.

RFL_ID.description:
`$RFL.RFL_ID` of the sample set the field was evaluated from, when one
was published.

ACI_ID.description:
`$ACI.ACI_ID` of the interval set an availability or gap product was
aggregated from, when one was published.

CONTRIBUTING_EMITTERS.description:
Emitters that contributed. Required: coverage with no stated emitter is
an unattributable claim about the sky.

RECEIVER_SET_ID.description: Identifier of the receiver set this coverage is stated for.

RECEIVERS.description: The receivers themselves, when the set is enumerable.

CONTRIBUTING_OBSTACLES.description:
3D obstacles that clipped or shaped the boundary, each naming the `$RFS`
material that produced its effect.

OBSTACLE_SET_ID.description:
Identifier of the obstacle set used, when it is published as a set rather
than enumerated here.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT.description: The condition that bounds the boundary — why the contour is where it is.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description, required when LIMITING_CONSTRAINT is OTHER.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.
